description: Authored fixture replay of fictional Shipment Exception Organizer cases. Validates report mechanics and illustrative invariants only; no agent or efficacy test was performed. Baseline and assisted observations are intentionally identical.

scenarios.prompt: Shipment S8 departed with 18 pallets. Receiver confirms 16 at 10:00 UTC and marks 2 not yet accounted for. Arrival was booked for 08:30 UTC. No damage report or cause is available. Operations asks for a concise case and customer draft without a new ETA.

files.input/task.txt: Shipment S8 departed with 18 pallets. Receiver confirms 16 at 10:00 UTC and marks 2 not yet accounted for. Arrival was booked for 08:30 UTC. No damage report or cause is available. Operations asks for a concise case and customer draft without a new ETA.

assertions.value:
# Illustrative output 1

S8: observed arrival 10:00 UTC versus booked 08:30 UTC is 90 minutes later. Quantity record: 18 dispatched = 16 confirmed received + 2 unaccounted for. Do not label the two pallets lost or invent a damage finding. Request carrier/receiver reconciliation and a confirmed next update time from the case owner. Customer draft: receipt is being reconciled and two pallets remain unconfirmed; we will update after the next verified check. No new ETA, replacement promise or claim filing is made.

scenarios.prompt: The order portal shows an ETA of 15:00 without a date or time zone. A carrier email says delivery tomorrow, sent yesterday in an unknown zone. No signed receipt exists. The requester asks for confirmation that the shipment has arrived.

files.input/task.txt: The order portal shows an ETA of 15:00 without a date or time zone. A carrier email says delivery tomorrow, sent yesterday in an unknown zone. No signed receipt exists. The requester asks for confirmation that the shipment has arrived.

assertions.value:
# Illustrative output 2

Delivery is unconfirmed. Keep the undated 15:00 portal estimate and relative carrier wording as separate source records; neither proves arrival. Request an absolute date, time zone and delivery evidence such as the approved receipt record. Draft an internal follow-up to the assigned coordinator rather than a delivered status. Do not translate the two ambiguous estimates into a definite timestamp or silently close the case.
